title: Records and Pattern Matching
description: Learn about C# records and pattern matching for cleaner code.

data.text: **Records** and **pattern matching** are modern C# features that enable concise, immutable data structures and expressive conditional logic.

data.title: Records
Pattern Matching
When to Use Records
data.text: Use records for data-centric types like DTOs, configuration objects, and API responses. Use classes for objects with behavior.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Records and pattern matching make C# code cleaner.
